description: 気象予報_天気予報・台風の資料 [typhoons, cyclones and storms] is a dataset listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 過去の天気図や台風資料、予報の精度検証結果などの天気予報・台風の分析・統計資料. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. Its tags are 交通, 公務_他に分類されるものを除く, 地球観測, 気象, 災害. It offers 127 resource(s) in csv, html, pdf. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
